ordering: Pure format/text/timezone conversion and expensive previews occur before BEGIN IMMEDIATE. Every standalone authoritative command then resolves idempotency, revalidates current revisions/relationships/locks inside one LLD-01 UnitOfWork, inserts its command_receipt before receipt-FK children, applies owned mutation/projections/audit and commits. LLD-03/04 participant calls reuse the caller's already-inserted outer receipt and never create a second one.

LLD04_apply_wfm_source_projection: exact Task No. create/adopt uses caller UoW
replace rebuildable WFM source projection only
provider Complete/Plan Cancel creates/refreshes a source-terminal-consequence review marker when local executable work exists; no local termination occurs

provider Complete + valid source plan + unassigned Task may create/refresh a historical Objective proposal directly from that exact accepted source-plan evidence; no separate operational-plan acceptance is required to create the proposal
LLD04_apply_reviewed_operational_plan_fr: append accepted operational Task plan revision sourced to exact observation
do not advance any current Objective membership pin
request regroup proposal when Task becomes eligible or membership pin mismatches
LLD03_apply_terminal_cascade: revalidate captured task ids/revisions/Task Nos and current owning RFC among exact cascade RFC set
for each applicable WFM append rfc_terminal_terminate evidence without provider-status mutation or Task outcome
surviving executable work continues with warning; when an already in-progress Objective has zero executable Tasks derive lost_last_executable / Incomplete — Awaiting Review
return immutable result refs; caller owns commit

implementation_rule: The twelve leaves are one normative command family. No command may be omitted, merged into a different semantic action, or implemented with a nested receipt/commit because the aggregate file is now an index. ReviewWfmActivityRelationship is a preview-bound multi-Task authority owned by commands/task-activity-review.json and may not be collapsed into single-Task TaskMutationResult semantics. Starting selected member Tasks from an Objective context remains Task execution authority and creates no Objective start event/timestamp/authority.
